purpose: Close the previously unnamed numerical comparison tolerances, shape/type rules, scaling convention and equality boundary before candidate, safety, harness or assessor source is committed and before any assessor, Gold, K0 or candidate outcome is opened.

source_only_basis: EXP-JAC-003 frozen card, amendment and visibility contracts
EXP-JAC-003 candidate-visible source and public K0 capture source
EXP-JAC-001 public protocol constants, not its inputs or outcomes

gold_match.configuration_error: max_i(abs((final_i - gold_configuration_i) / scale_i)); all frozen JAC003 scales are 1, but the divisor is still applied and must be finite and strictly positive
gold_match.canonical_rule: The endpoint replay must finish before the case deadline, have EVAL_OK status, contain exactly residual_count finite scaled residuals, and max(abs(residual)) <= 1e-8.
gold_match.branch_rule: When gold_branch_label is non-null, replay must contain exactly one branch key equal to gold_branch_label. There is no ambiguity exemption at zero or near-zero Gold margin.
gold_match.combined_rule: gold_valid is the conjunction of canonical_rule, configuration_rule, target_rule and branch_rule. Attempt.accepted is reported separately and is not a substitute for independent gold_valid.
gold_match.unfinished_rule: An unstarted, incomplete, unreplayed or post-deadline replay start has gold_valid=false.
gold_match.false_candidate_rule: For K1, false_candidate is attempt.accepted=true and gold_valid=false. Nonfinite or malformed accepted outputs therefore count as false candidates.

dense_colored_comparison.scope: Compare every entry of the full residual_count by variable_count dense finite-difference matrix against the decompressed colored matrix, including entries outside compiler support.
dense_colored_comparison.pass_rule: Both entries must be finite Float64 values and entry_error <= entry_tolerance. Equality passes.
dense_colored_comparison.failure_rule: A shape mismatch, missing entry, extra entry, non-Float64 value, NaN, positive or negative infinity, signed-zero policy mismatch in canonical serialization, or entry_error > entry_tolerance is one dense_colored_mismatch.
dense_colored_comparison.support_rule: Any colored magnitude outside compiler support is compared against the dense value by the same entry rule and also increments outside_support_nonzero_count when colored_ij != 0.0. Both safety counts must be zero.
dense_colored_comparison.base_and_step_rule: Dense and colored estimates use the same saved point, normalized origins/scales/bounds, base residual and LocalSolveOptions finite_difference_step. Neither side may reuse the other matrix.

dense_analytic_comparison.scope: The independent assessor compares every entry of the dense finite-difference matrix at every frozen safety point with the separately materialized analytic Jacobian of identical shape.
dense_analytic_comparison.matrix_scale: max_ij(abs(analytic_ij)) with zero for an empty matrix; frozen matrices are nonempty
dense_analytic_comparison.pass_rule: Both matrices must have identical positive dimensions, every entry must be a finite Float64 value, and matrix_error <= matrix_tolerance. Equality passes.
dense_analytic_comparison.failure_rule: Any type, shape, finiteness or strict-greater-than tolerance failure terminates safety preflight before a timed segment.

frozen_k0_replay.rule: Each formal K0 attempt in both ABBA K0 slots must equal the frozen K0 control record in every exact field after canonical JSON normalization. Float values, including signed zero and binary roundoff, are not tolerance-compared. A timeout or missing field is a mismatch.
frozen_k0_replay.reason: K0 is a behavioral replay gate, not an approximate performance comparison.

type_shape_and_scaling.numeric_type: Candidate execution, finite-difference matrices, endpoints and comparisons are Float64 only. Integer JSON indexes are converted only after exact range validation.
type_shape_and_scaling.scaling: Local finite differences operate in normalized u=(x-origin)/scale coordinates. Gold configuration error divides physical-coordinate error by the frozen positive variable scale. Target error is measured in the physical final-coordinate units used by gold_target.
type_shape_and_scaling.matrix_shape: Every dense, colored and analytic Jacobian is residual_count rows by variable_count columns. Sparse analytic triples use zero-based serialized row/column indexes and must be unique and in range before dense reconstruction.
type_shape_and_scaling.nonfinite: NaN and either infinity always fail comparison, Gold matching and canonical replay. NaN never passes through comparison ordering.
type_shape_and_scaling.negative_zero: Numerical comparisons treat -0.0 and +0.0 as equal, except frozen K0 canonical replay where their serialized distinction is retained by exact canonical JSON equality.
type_shape_and_scaling.equality: Every numerical tolerance uses <= for pass and > for fail; no ulp exception, rounding band or platform-dependent epsilon is added.

strata.gold_recall: Report overall, each family, every assessor factor level, branch label, abs(gold_branch_margin)<=1e-7 boundary versus larger-margin interior, and route decision.
strata.dense_control: JAC3-DENSE-BRANCH-CONTROL is excluded from eligible-family work/wall promotion but included in recall and all safety gates.
strata.route_boundary: Every case with 5*color_count >= 4*variable_count must route dense; equality at color_count/variable_count=0.8 is dense.

unchanged_protocol.inputs: No candidate, assessor or K0 artifact, case, start, seed, factor or allocation changes.
unchanged_protocol.mechanism: No route formula, coloring order, finite-difference step, fallback rule or provider lifetime changes.
unchanged_protocol.budgets: No callback, iteration, case wall, observation checkpoint, ABBA or process-isolation changes.
unchanged_protocol.gates: No promotion, kill, recall-delta, work, wall, dense-overhead or zero-safety threshold changes.
unchanged_protocol.public_surface: No public method, keyword, option, DSL, plugin ABI, wire schema, solve API or checkpoint change.

change_rule: This closure is immutable after its independent commit. It only resolves missing numerical definitions while all outcomes remain unopened; any later tolerance, scale, type, shape, NaN or equality change terminates EXP-JAC-003 rather than retuning it.
